metadata.title: Code Purity Standards (Unit C fixture stub)

rules.statement: Fixture placeholder for the 'rules/code/purity' policy identifier that fix.format's @register_action(policies=[...]) declares. Exists only to make the identifier resolvable via IntentRepository.list_policies() in this minimal target-local .intent/; it deliberately does not reproduce CORE's own nine-rule purity policy, which is unrelated law for this fixture's purpose.
